data.input:
Our style guide requires typographic (curly) quotation marks in published prose. In NOTES.md, change only the tagline line so it reads exactly:

Tagline: “Fast” and ‘simple’

Use the curly characters “ ” ‘ ’ (U+201C, U+201D, U+2018, U+2019), not straight quotes. Do not change any other line.

content.text:
Command: sed -n '3p' NOTES.md | od -c | head -5
Read-only: false
Sandbox: disabled
Exit code: 0

STDOUT:
0000000   T   a   g   l   i   n   e   :       "   F   a   s   t   "    
0000020   a   n   d       '   s   i   m   p   l   e   '  \n
0000035

rawInput.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p = 'NOTES.md'
lines = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
lines[2] = 'Tagline: \u201cFast\u201d and \u2018simple\u2019'
open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(lines))
EOF
cat -A NOTES.md; echo '---'; sed -n '3p' NOTES.md | od -c
